scenes.title: Your guitar, up close
scenes.subtitle: The parts of the guitar and how to hold it.
lines: In this lesson, you'll learn the parts of your guitar and how to hold it.

scenes.heading: Welcome!
lines: This course will take you from never having played to playing full songs.
The app listens through your phone's microphone, so keep it near the guitar in a quiet room.
We'll go step by step, together.
Let's begin with your guitar, up close.

scenes.heading: Parts of the guitar
points: Body holds sound hole or pickups
lines: The headstock holds the tuning pegs where the strings start.
The neck leads to the fretboard, marked by metal frets.
The body is where the sound hole or pickups sit, and the bridge anchors the strings.
Everything connects to create music — take your time to get familiar with each part.

scenes.heading: Holding the guitar
points: Sit straight, guitar on right leg
Neck up left, forearm over body
lines: Sit up straight and rest the guitar body on your right leg.
Point the neck slightly upward to the left, with your strumming forearm over the body.
Keep your fretting-hand thumb behind the neck and relax your shoulders — it's all about comfort and control.
You've got the guitar in position, ready to play.
Let's move to the next step and start exploring the fretboard together.
